results.description: Munch–Picasso (30 October 2026 – 28 February 2027) brings together, for the first time, the work of Edvard Munch (1863–1944) and Pablo Picasso (1881–1973), two pivotal figures in the emergence of modern art. Through more than one hundred paintings, drawings and prints, the exhibition ...

highlights:
[Munch-Picasso]

The exhibition *Munch-Picasso* is organised into thematic sections over two floors of the Museo Picasso Málaga. This presentation makes it possible to establish a dialogue between the works of the two artists, exploring their stylistic affinities, existential concerns and shared themes such as love, death, loneliness, anguish, sexuality and modern life, offering new perspectives on two of the key figures of 20th-century art.

…

For over three decades, and until May 2026, she was the chief-curator of modern painting at the Museo Nacional Thyssen-Bornemisza. There, she led research projects and curated major exhibitions on modern masters such as Pablo Picasso and Edvard Munch. She has held academic research fellowships at the Clark Art Institute in Williamstown (2010) and the Getty Research Institute in Los Angeles (2016).
